summary: Full frontend QA of the redesigned donation/crowdfunding page — real campaign /pay?d=zEJtCe (The Dev Store) + sandbox /pay/donation-demo. Verified all requested testids, bug fixes (interpolation + supporter-wall medal/amount overlap), form validation, donate→checkout hand-off with mocked APIs, mobile layout, dark mode, and all 4 sandbox scenarios. Everything passes with zero console/page errors.

bug_fix_1_interpolation.fund_handling_body: Your gift goes directly to The Dev Store. Depending on their settings it's received as crypto or automatically converted to a stablecoin. DynoPay only processes the payment — it never holds or invests your donation.

form_validation.invalid_email_error: Please enter a valid email address, or leave it blank.

checkout_handoff.coin_selection_ui: Network chips (Polygon/Ethereum/Tron) + 'Continue with USDT on Polygon' button (no clean-checkout-coin-ETH testid — different UI)

critical_code_review_comments: Coin selection UI on checkout no longer exposes per-coin testids like 'clean-checkout-coin-ETH' as stated in the review request. The current checkout renders a coin dropdown + network chips + single 'Continue with USDT on Polygon' button. Not a bug — flagging so testids in future specs align with current UI (or add data-testid on each network chip like 'clean-checkout-network-Polygon' / on the continue button 'clean-checkout-continue-btn').
seed_data_creation: Donate click on QA campaign created 1 expected pending child link: new ref = hnKv05 (link_id ~= 612). All /api/pay/addPayment and verifyCryptoPayment calls were mocked — no real pool address was reserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Donation page redesign fully verified. If retesting, use route mocks for /api/pay/addPayment and /api/pay/verifyCryptoPayment* before clicking donate on zEJtCe to avoid reserving real addresses. Every donate click creates a new child link (ref rotates) — that is expected.
